Thee Old Night is a dark, minimalist folk trio based out of North Carolina and Richmond, Va. The group blends elements of psychedelia, classic country, and traditional doom metal into an unprecedented, spectral sound focused on melody, meditation, and the liminal spaces between established genre norms. 

The group began as a solo foray for Erik Sugg, following his years of fronting the celebrated doom metal outfit, Demon Eye, and his work as a guitarist and songwriter for Ripple Records
